title: Identifies and describes a peripheral used in an experiment

identifier.description: An identifier for the peripheral in the context of the instrument it is attached to

path.description: The path to the peripheral from the perspective of the instrument it is attached to.

assignedName.description: The name assigned to the peripheral by the user

signalType.description: The type of signal the peripheral uses to communicate with the instrument

unit.description: The primary unit associated with the peripheral from an experiment / operational view, if any.
